empty_reason.message: Capacity Source has no live listings yet: the first providers are being onboarded. The introduction terms do not hide listings: every caller sees every live listing's teaser, and accepting the terms opens a listing's specs.

program.headline: New data center capacity listings are coming soon
how_it_works: Search listings by size (kW or MW) and location — region, country, state or market — and see when each was last updated, without an account.
Sign in with a free account, or connect an identified AI agent, and accept the introduction terms once to see a listing's specs.
Register for a listing. DC Hub checks the request, then sends the provider your company name and requirement; when the provider accepts, DC Hub shares the site details and contacts with both sides.
program.name: DC Hub Capacity Source
program.note: The first listings are being onboarded. Register a requirement to get first access when they open.

sellers.disclosure: Some listings are represented by Martone Advisors, DC Hub's affiliated advisory: https://dchub.cloud/listings/how-it-works#disclosure

prefill.how: Add what your human already told you as URL parameters before #list-capacity; the form opens filled in and they check it and submit. Leave out anything you do not know.

list_free.terms: Free to list; a 2% service fee only if a deal closes.

program.summary: Powered land, powered shells and turnkey capacity to buy or lease, for enterprise buyers and the AI agents that procure for them. Search by size and location; every listing shows when it was last updated. Sign in and accept the introduction terms once to see a listing's specs, then register for it: when the provider accepts, DC Hub shares the site details and contacts.

terms.summary: DC Hub records your registration in its lead register and sends the operator your company name and stated requirement so it can accept or decline the registration. Only if the operator accepts does DC Hub share your name, role, email and message with the operator, and the operator's identity, site details and contact with you. If it declines, neither side's contact details are shared. For 12 months you agree to pursue a listed opportunity through DC Hub rather than approaching its operator directly.

buyer_sees: listing specs, only once signed in with the introduction terms accepted

who_sees_what.human_approval: an agent sends a registration only after its human approves it and agrees to these terms

buyer_sees: no operator identity, site details or contact
operator_sees: nothing beyond the company name and requirement already sent

who_sees_what.through_dc_hub: for 12 months from registration, a listed opportunity is pursued through DC Hub, not by approaching its operator directly
